stem.en: The dots show the farmer's five combinations: barley along the bottom, wheat up the side. Moving from B to C gives 25 kg more barley. How much wheat is given up?

text.en: 10 kg: the same as the previous step from A to B.
30 kg: that is what the following step, C to D, will cost.
20 kg: wheat drops from 90 to 70 between B and C.
25 kg: the sacrifice must equal the barley gained.

explanation.en: At B the farmer grows 90 kg of wheat; at C only 70 kg. So the extra 25 kg of barley costs 90 − 70 = 20 kg of wheat. Option (a) is the cost of the step before, (b) is the cost of the next step, and (d) wrongly assumes one kilogram of wheat for each kilogram of barley.

hints.en: Read the wheat at B and at C, then subtract.
